purpose: Exploratory CONCH-Z image-text ranking on H&E lymph-node patches; scores are not calibrated probabilities or diagnoses.
templates: H&E-stained lymph node tissue showing CLASSNAME
a histology patch of lymph node tissue with CLASSNAME

tumor: metastatic carcinoma involving lymph node tissue
carcinoma cell clusters within a lymph node
normal: normal lymph node tissue without carcinoma

selection_score: For each class, average its normalized synonym/template text embeddings and normalize that average. Rank tissue patches by cosine to tumor class embedding minus cosine to normal class embedding.
evaluation: At fixed top-K, report the fraction of positive slides with at least one selected patch overlapping the tumor mask, patch precision among selected patches, and the same metrics for a spatial/random baseline. Normal slides have no tumor mask positives.
